name: codingbaddie-skills
description: Rachel Weng's PM skills for Claude: BRD writing and review, a senior-PM consultant, and illustrated user manuals.

plugins.name: brd-writer
plugins.description: For business / professional-services teams: an interview-style skill that turns a vague pain point into a BRD a software PM can make decisions on, then self-checks it against evidence.

plugins.name: brd-reviewer
plugins.description: For PMs: review a received BRD, find information gaps, and produce a follow-up question list ready to send to the requester; across several BRDs, flag where requirements collide.

plugins.name: rachel-pm-skill
plugins.description: A senior-PM consultant mode for software product work: trade-offs with every recommendation, align before acting, story splitting, decision logs, and functional spec templates.

plugins.name: manual-writer
plugins.description: Write and iterate illustrated user manuals by browsing production with Claude in Chrome, capturing real screenshots, keeping Markdown as the source of truth, and exporting Word.
